description: The entity does not restrict the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes and does not protect it during transmission, movement, or removal.
applicability: Data transfer, encryption in transit, data movement

metadata.detection_notes: Review data transmission mechanisms, encryption protocols (TLS/SSL), data transfer policies, and controls over data movement. Test whether data is protected during transmission across networks.
